start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:validate-and-launch-a-subscription-app." Take a consumer app idea from a painful daily problem to a live subscription app: confirm that apps in the category already earn and that creators already post about the problem (stop if not), record the top 3 competitors' onboarding beats, paywall, price and growth channels from the person's own screenshots, write an onboarding that follows the winning order of beats in original words and design, end it with a paywall that states price, trial and cancellation plainly, publish a store page whose subtitle says what the app does, then run five growth channels (creators paid per post, influencers on a capped cost per 1,000 views, faceless slideshows, founder-made posts, paid ads after organic winners) with disclosures, and review installs, trials, paid users and revenue every week.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.

3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is weekly.
